newsitem.title: KAZAKHSTAN: Kazakhstan Jan '97 trade surplus at $183 mln.
newsitem.headline: Kazakhstan Jan '97 trade surplus at $183 mln.

text.p: Kazakhstan posted a foreign trade surplus of $183.2 million in January, against a positive trade balance of $208.0 million in the same month last year, the National Statistics Committee said on Wednesday.
